data.subject: Re: Vendor shortlist for the Q4 RFP
data.body: Hi Marcus,On Sept 22 you said you'd get me those two by Thursday. Today is Sept 23, just one day before the deadline - happy to help if anything's blocking it. If you've already sent them over, just a quick note to confirm receipt would be great. Let me know if you need anything from my side. No rush, just wanted to keep things on track.Sam
